subject: Follow-up: MAP technical benchmark milestones & next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@healthgrid.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: MAP technical benchmark milestones & next steps

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion I drafted the Technical Evaluation milestone for the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and wanted to confirm the proposed scope, owners, and timing so we can lock the benchmark window. High level summary below — please review and flag anything missing.

Milestone: Technical Evaluation Plan (MAP) — Redwood & HealthGrid
- Goal: Validate model variant(s) for production workload: meet latency & cost targets while preserving accuracy on HealthGrid clinical paraphrasing tasks.
- Success criteria (initial draft):
  * Latency: p95 token response <= 350 ms for 1K-context, single-request (no batching) in US region.
  * Throughput: sustained 50 tokens/sec for 16 concurrent sessions (target service-level throughput).
  * Quality: top-line BLEU-like score (task-specific metric) >= 0.78 on the provided eval set; fewer than 2% clinically meaningful regressions vs current baseline.
  * Cost: incremental inference cost <= $18 per 1M generated tokens at target settings (quantized runtime).
- Model shortlist (to run in the harness): Mistral-Instruct-30B, Llama-3-13B-quant, Falcon-40B-astral. (We can add an extra candidate if you prefer.)

Responsibilities (proposed):
- Redwood (Rishi / Vanessa): deliver benchmark harness + runner scripts, run models in hosted private test environment, provide result deck.
- HealthGrid (Alex / Priya): share sanitized sample dataset (jsonl), provide S3 access and test credentials, confirm target evaluation metric and priority cases.
- Marissa: coordinate procurement/PO and finalize target close milestone on the MAP.

Target dates:
- Dataset & creds delivered by: 2026-07-29
- Test infra provisioned by Redwood: 2026-08-05
- Benchmark run window: 2026-08-06 — 2026-08-12
- Results & joint readout: 2026-08-19
- MAP milestone close / decision: 2026-08-26

Dependencies / blockers:
- SOC2 evidence & Data processing addendum (DPA) must be agreed to before access.
- HealthGrid to confirm exact success metric (task-specific scoring function) by 2026-07-27.
- Budget approval / PO in place for Dedicated trial (if needed) — target by 2026-08-02.

Attachments included: MAP-draft-HealthGrid-v1.pdf (MAP text), benchmark-test-plan.csv (test cases template).

Please reply with any edits or "+1" to accept the milestone and owners. If this looks good I'll update the shared MAP doc and create the HubSpot milestone entry.

Best,
Rishi
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@healthgrid.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@healthgrid.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:43:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: MAP technical benchmark milestones & next steps

Thanks Rishi, this is very clear — appreciate the concrete targets. +1 on the schedule and owners with two notes from our side:

1) Data / PHI: sample dataset will be de-identified but still contains clinical labels. We have a strict requirement that benchmark runs occur in a US-only region and under SOC 2 controls. We will share the DPA template along with S3 access.
2) Chunking & tokenization: our evaluation includes multi-paragraph clinical notes that are often long — please ensure the harness supports sliding-window evaluation so we capture context-sensitive behavior.

We can deliver a small sample dataset (5k records) by 2026-07-29 as requested. Procurement will begin the PO path this week.

Will loop in procurement contacts as needed, and confirm final scoring function (we prefer an F1-style metric tuned for entity recall).

— Alex
Head of ML & Data Engineering
HealthGrid

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:12:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: MAP technical benchmark milestones & next steps (internal assignment)

Looping internally to confirm actions and timing — copying Alex's note for context. Internal owners below: please treat these as firm unless you push back.

Action items / owners:
- Vanessa: finalize harness design & sliding-window tokenization by 2026-07-28. Deliverable: harness README + runbook.
- Connor: provision US-only test cluster, SOC2 controls checklist, and temporary creds by 2026-08-05. Deliverable: infra handoff ticket + access notes (healthgrid-s3-access-instructions.txt).
- Rishi: confirm model shortlist and coordinate candidate config matrix (quantization settings, context lengths) by 2026-07-24.
- Marissa (me): push procurement/PO with HealthGrid contact and get DocuSign MSA out; target PO submitted by 2026-08-02.

Benchmark success thresholds (internal refinement):
- p95 latency <= 350 ms at 1k context (single-threaded),
- mean token generation cost <= $18 / 1M tokens (post-quantization),
- entity-recall F1 >= 0.82 on the evaluation set,
- <= 2% of outputs flagged as clinically incorrect in spot-check sample.

Attachments I'm uploading to the MAP folder: MAP-draft-HealthGrid-v1.pdf, benchmark-test-plan.csv.

Connor & Vanessa — if you hit any infra/legal blockers escalate to me by 2026-07-26 so we don't slip the benchmark window.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
